question: A regular polygon has 2n sides. What is the angle made between two adjacent sides (in degrees)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Interior angle of regular polygon = [(n−2)/n] × 180°

Here sides = 2n

⇒ Angle = [(2n − 2)/(2n)] × 180

= [(n − 1)/n] × 180

= 180 − 180/n = (1 - (1)/(n)) times 180^circ 

**∴ Answer = (1 - (1)/(n)) times 180^circ **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of sides = 2n

**Formula used:**

Interior angle = [(Number of sides − 2)/Number of sides] × 180°

**Calculation:**

⇒ Interior angle = [(2n − 2)/(2n)] × 180°

⇒ = [(n − 1)/n] × 180°

⇒ = 180° − (180/n) = (1 - (1)/(n)) times 180^circ 

**∴ The correct answer is (1 - (1)/(n)) times 180^circ **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Interior Angle Formula

[(n − 2)/n] × 180°

Regular Polygon

All sides and angles are equal

Exterior Angle

= 360° / number of sides

Quick Tip

Interior angle = 180° − exterior angle
